model.quantization: exl3-4bit routed experts; q4 dense; fp8 KV

container.name: tensorfold-glm53-flash-exl3-1m
container.gpus: all 4 NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3; one rank per GPU

platform_notes: The published recipe image is linux/arm64; this host runs a locally built linux/amd64 image from the same TensorFold v0.6.0 + patches.
start.sh targets 2-3 DGX Sparks over SSH/RoCE; this host runs one container with four ranks, one GPU each, all GPUs visible for NCCL/NVLink.
The NGC image sets NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=spcx (Spectrum-X); this non-RDMA host requires NCCL_NET_PLUGIN=none and NCCL_GIN_ENABLE=0.
TensorFold's GLM engine hardcodes cuda:0; the container entrypoint patches it to honor TF_GLM_DEVICE per rank.
profile.qualification: Interface smoke (chat, reasoning, tool call, vision) passed. Capacity/decode/retrieval screens are recorded in docs/GLM53_RESULTS.md. Not a sustained-load or production-tail qualification.

## 1. Scope and Method

This report analyzes 18 condition-monitoring records spanning five asset classes (compressors, reactors, pipelines, valves, condensers, scrubbers, and heat exchangers) across 20 stations. Each record contains five measured parameters: pressure (kPa), temperature (°C), flow (m³/h), vibration (mm/s RMS), and efficiency (%). The analysis proceeds in three stages:

# Technical Analysis of Plant Records: Units 0000000–0000017

## 1. Executive Summary

This report analyzes 18 equipment records spanning eight asset classes (heat exchangers, condensers, turbines, pipelines, compressors, separators, scrubbers, valves, reactors, and pumps) across stations 14–371. The dataset shows several units operating with anomalies that warrant follow-up: two units with elevated vibration (Record 0000003, pipeline unit 3772 at 8.1 mm/s; Record 0000002, turbine unit 3938 at 7.9 mm/s), several units with depressed efficiency (turbine 3938 at 71%, valve 5365 at 73%, condenser 1259 at 73%, heat exchanger 1346 at 74%, reactor 2282 at 75%), and one unit with an anomalous low flow reading (reactor 2282 at 43 m³/h). No single record shows an imminent catastrophic failure signature, but the combination of high vibration plus low efficiency on the turbine, and low flow plus low efficiency on reactor 2282, are the two highest-priority investigation targets.
